card.title: The Final Word
card.instruction: Treat every opinion you offer as a ruling and every continued discussion as an appeal.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Green suits our hallway. That's settled; I'll get the rollers.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I live here too. Can we try my blue sample?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your appeal can have one square beside the radiator.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Fine. We'll ask our daughter which she prefers.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: She can hear the appeal. I'll explain why green won before you show her the square.
